svg.text: a phyllotaxis & hygroscopic-hinge plate, drawn procedurally — October 10, 2026
A · 137.508°, the golden angle — scales pack without gaps; 13 arms (red) run one way,
8 (olive) run the other. Count them: consecutive Fibonacci numbers.
and the spirals melt into spokes.
spokes again, leaning the other way.
winged seeds released to the wind
wood layers swell unevenly with humidity
A pinecone is a seed factory older than flowers (~300 Myr), whose scales are set by the most irrational number there is —
so no two ever line up, and no space goes to waste. Count the spirals on any real cone this weekend: 8 and 13, most likely.
